collection.title: Renault Mascott 1999 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Mascott 1999 to 2010 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm and has built-in washer jets.
